title: Patriots 53-man roster projection 1.0: Will New England really stick with 7 receivers?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Patriots' wide receiver roster includes A.J. Brown and potentially Kayshon Boutte amid trade considerations.
Drake Maye, Tommy DeVito, and Behren Morton projected as Patriots' three quarterbacks for 2026.
New England's linebacker corps features Robert Spillane, Christian Elliss, Chad Muma, and undrafted rookie Khalil Jacobs.

title: Adley Rutschman could make his Red Sox debut in coming days
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Adley Rutschman, acquired from the Orioles, may debut with the Red Sox soon, possibly Tuesday in Toronto.
Rutschman, recovering from wrist inflammation, played two rehab games with Triple-A Worcester last weekend.
The Red Sox lost a series to the Athletics, their first series loss since early July.

title: Healey signs bill allowing state to take Norwood Hospital through eminent domain
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Governor Maura Healey signed a bill allowing Massachusetts to seize Norwood Hospital via eminent domain for nonprofit use.
The state can take the property from Medical Properties Trust starting November 1 to complete stalled hospital construction.
Norwood Hospital remained vacant since 2020 floods; construction halted when Steward Health Care filed for bankruptcy.

title: Dozens displaced by building collapse in Springfield
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: A severe thunderstorm caused a building collapse at 265 Dwight St. Ext. in Springfield displacing 45 residents.
Mayor Sarno declared a state of emergency as storms caused power outages, downed trees, and knocked out power lines.
The Red Cross assists those displaced, and Eversource sent crews from Connecticut to help restore power.

title: Adam Vinatieri jokes about Bill Belichick, Deflategate as part of Hall-of-Fame speech
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Adam Vinatieri was inducted into the Pro Football Hall of Fame, reflecting on his 24-year NFL career.
During his speech, Vinatieri joked about Bill Belichick and addressed the Patriots' 'Deflategate' controversy.
Vinatieri praised Patriots fans and teammates, acknowledging their support and collaborative achievements.

title: Mass. 7-year-old hit and killed by vehicle while riding bike
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: A 7-year-old was fatally struck by a vehicle while riding a bicycle in Williamstown, Massachusetts.
The incident occurred at Main Street and Buxton Hill Road; the child reportedly entered the street unintentionally.
The vehicle's driver was not impaired; no arrests or charges have been made, investigation ongoing.

title: Residents urged to keep pets out of Stoughton pond after dog’s death
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Stoughton officials advise residents to avoid swimming in Ames Pond after a dog's death potentially linked to an algae bloom.
The Board of Health is investigating the water safety; no E. Coli issue found, but algae blooms are suspected.
Cyanobacterial algae blooms can be harmful to humans and deadly to pets, prompting weekly water safety tests.

title: Former NH state trooper decertified after misleading police about using GPS to track girlfriend
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: James Lamoureux, a former NH state trooper, is decertified for misleading police about GPS tracking devices on his and his girlfriend's vehicles.
Lamoureux pleaded guilty to false reporting and will serve a suspended six-month prison sentence per a negotiated resolution.
He will resign from the state police force, surrender his certification, and be prohibited from future law enforcement positions.

title: Man polishing powder horn outside Lexington church prompts bizarre police response
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Lexington police responded to Grace Chapel after reports of a man with a gun, leading to a lockdown.
The man, an 'avid period reenactor,' was polishing a musket-era powder horn while waiting for his wife.
Police confirmed there was no public threat, closing parts of Worthen Road briefly during the response.

title: Longtime sports analyst Rob Parker not sold that Red Sox will make playoffs
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Rob Parker doubts Red Sox can sustain their high performance and reach the playoffs in 2026.
Red Sox have a 64-52 record, holding the second A.L. wild-card spot with a 96% playoff chance.
Boston achieved the best 30-game and 37-game streaks in franchise history with recent winning performances.
